r34l1sm, SCENE 2 — QUESTION 2 (THE BLUE WHALE)


Authentic modern VLOG-style video featuring the same male character from <Picture 1>. Preserve exactly the same face, hairstyle, clothing, body proportions, and identity from Scene 1.

Natural handheld smartphone-camera energy, realistic lighting, creator-style framing, expressive reactions, energetic pacing, and playful physical comedy.

IMPORTANT VIEWER INTERACTION RULE:
The character speaks DIRECTLY TO THE VIEWER with the same natural MALE FILIPINO-ACCENTED ENGLISH VOICE from Scene 1.

The camera represents the viewer.

[Shot 1 — 0:00–0:05]

CONTINUITY FROM PREVIOUS SCENE:

The host flies sideways into the frame exactly as if the giant wind gust from Scene 1 has thrown him into this location.

He lands awkwardly on a wooden seaside boardwalk.

[AUDIO: Heavy THUD]

The handheld camera quickly swings downward to find him.

The host immediately gets back onto his feet, brushes dust from his shirt, looks straight into the camera, and pretends nothing happened.

Behind him is a bright blue ocean.

He points directly at the viewer.

HOST:
<d>[English, Male Filipino Accent] Okay, next one! What is the largest animal known to have ever lived on Earth?</d>

The host immediately stops speaking and waits.

[Shot 2 — 0:05–0:10]

No dialogue. Five-second viewer countdown.

Camera becomes stable.

Place the host slightly RIGHT-OF-CENTER this time.

Reserve completely clean negative space in the UPPER-LEFT portion of the frame.

MINIMAX H3 OPTIMIZED TIMER:
Display exactly ONE enormous bold WHITE number in the upper-left negative space.

NO box.
NO circle.
NO progress ring.
NO progress bar.
NO clock.
NO timer icon.
NO additional words.
NO duplicated numbers.

Only ONE number exists on screen at any moment.

Pure bright white #FFFFFF.

Very thick, heavy sans-serif font.

The number occupies approximately 20% of the frame height.

Each number completely replaces the previous number using an instantaneous HARD CUT.

Exact sequence:

5
then 4
then 3
then 2
then 1

Each number remains visible for exactly one second.

AUDIO SYNCHRONIZATION RULE:
Exactly ONE short mechanical "CLICK" occurs at the precise frame each number appears.

Total silence between clicks.

No spoken countdown.
No background music.

TIMELINE:

At 5:
[AUDIO: One sharp CLICK]
Huge WHITE "5".
Host puts both hands on his hips.

At 4:
[AUDIO: One sharp CLICK]
The "5" disappears completely.
Huge WHITE "4" replaces it.
Host looks toward the ocean thoughtfully.

At 3:
[AUDIO: One sharp CLICK]
The "4" disappears completely.
Huge WHITE "3" replaces it.
Host scratches his chin.

At 2:
[AUDIO: One sharp CLICK]
The "3" disappears completely.
Huge WHITE "2" replaces it.
Host points toward the viewer as if asking, "You sure?"

At 1:
[AUDIO: One sharp CLICK]
The "2" disappears completely.
Huge WHITE "1" replaces it.
Host nods confidently and gives the camera a thumbs-up.

NO SPOKEN COUNTDOWN.

[Shot 3 — 0:10–0:13]

The countdown disappears completely.

The handheld camera rapidly swings around toward the ocean.

A gigantic blue whale dramatically breaches from the water behind the host.

A massive wall of ocean spray explodes upward.

The camera quickly swings back toward the host.

A dark charcoal rectangular answer card appears beside him.

Exactly ONE line of enormous bold WHITE uppercase text:

BLUE WHALE!

HOST:
<d>[English, Male Filipino Accent] The blue whale! It's the largest animal known to have ever lived!</d>

[Shot 4 — 0:13–0:15]

The host proudly points toward the enormous whale behind him.

He looks back at the camera with a huge grin.

Then the delayed wall of water from the whale breach crashes directly over him.

[AUDIO: Massive SPLASH]

The camera lens becomes completely covered in water.

The host is barely visible through the wet lens, standing completely soaked and staring silently at the camera with an annoyed expression.

He slowly wipes the lens with his hand.

Hard cut.
